result.instructions: Tools for Geocodio, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What are the coordinates of 1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington DC?"; "Geocode this list of 500 customer addresses and tell me how many failed."; "Which address is at coordinates 38.886672, -77.094735?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Geocodio data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run geocodio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run geocodio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run geocodio_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. geocodio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: geocodio_geocode_address
tools.title: Geocode one address
tools.description: Forward geocoding: turn one address into coordinates and standard address parts. Pass q, or the parts (street, city, state_province, postal_code). Geocodio REST: GET /geocode.

q.description: The full address as one string, e.g. '1109 N Highland St, Arlington VA'.

street.description: Street line, when not using q.

state_province.description: State or province, when not using q.

postal_code.description: Postal code, when not using q.

fields.description: Comma-separated data fields to append, e.g. 'cd,stateleg,timezone'. Each field adds one lookup.

tools.name: geocodio_geocode_batch
tools.title: Geocode many addresses
tools.description: Batch forward geocoding for up to 1000 addresses in one call. Geocodio REST: POST /geocode with a JSON array. Each address and each field is one lookup.

addresses.description: Addresses to geocode, one string each (up to 1000 per call).

fields.description: Comma-separated data fields to append, e.g. 'cd,stateleg,timezone'. Each field adds one lookup.

tools.name: geocodio_reverse_coordinates
tools.title: Reverse geocode one point
tools.description: Reverse geocoding: turn one latitude and longitude into the nearest address. Geocodio REST: GET /reverse.

fields.description: Comma-separated data fields to append, e.g. 'cd,stateleg,timezone'. Each field adds one lookup.

tools.name: geocodio_reverse_batch
tools.title: Reverse geocode many points
tools.description: Batch reverse geocoding for up to 1000 'lat,lng' strings in one call. Geocodio REST: POST /reverse with a JSON array.

fields.description: Comma-separated data fields to append, e.g. 'cd,stateleg,timezone'. Each field adds one lookup.

tools.name: geocodio_parse_address
tools.title: Parse an address
tools.description: Split one free-form address into its components (street, city, state, zip). Geocodio REST: GET /parse.

tools.name: geocodio_distance_from_origin
tools.title: Distances from one origin
tools.description: Distance and drive time from one origin to up to many destinations. Addresses or 'lat,lng' strings work. Geocodio REST: GET /distance.

tools.name: geocodio_distance_matrix
tools.title: Distance matrix
tools.description: Distances between many origins and many destinations, or one-to-one pairs. Geocodio REST: POST /distance-matrix. Each origin-destination pair is one lookup.

tools.name: geocodio_list_spreadsheets
tools.title: List uploaded spreadsheets
tools.description: Show the geocoding lists (uploaded spreadsheets) on the account, one page at a time. Geocodio REST: GET /lists. Needs a key with list access.

tools.name: geocodio_get_list_status
tools.title: Get list status
tools.description: Show the processing status of one geocoding list (WAITING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED or FAILED). Geocodio REST: GET /lists/{id}.

tools.name: geocodio_download_list_results
tools.title: Download list results
tools.description: Download the results of a COMPLETED geocoding list as CSV text. Geocodio REST: GET /lists/{id}/download. Large lists can exceed the result cap.

tools.name: geocodio_delete_list
tools.title: Delete a list
tools.description: Delete one geocoding list and its results from the account. This cannot be undone. Geocodio REST: DELETE /lists/{id}.

prompts.title: Get started with Geocodio
prompts.description: What you can do with Geocodio here, with example requests to try.
